_comment: Copy to <repo>/.claude/quality-gates.json to tune crap-gate.py (developer stop + commit) and mutation.py (code reviewer) for the repo. Without this file they still run: every language with a home profile (~/.claude/config/home.json toolchains) whose extensions match a file tracked at the diff base or added or changed by the branch is enabled on the profile alone, and so is such a language this file doesn't list (outside "exclude"); gate messages say a language was enabled automatically. "languages": {"<lang>": false} turns a language off. Each language listed here is laid over the home profile of that name, so a key it omits comes from there and a key it has replaces the profile's wholesale (lists too; [] turns a list off). A gate command that can't run (tool missing, e.g. pytest-cov) blocks, naming the key to override here. python has extensions, coverage (--cov={changed_dirs}: the changed files' directories), coverage_format, test, invalid_exit_codes, red_invalid_exit_codes, red_invalid_patterns; go has extensions, go_bin, coverage, coverage_format, test, invalid_patterns, red_invalid_patterns, checks (gofmt -l, go vet). Both also give scratch_exclude defaults, used only when this file has no scratch_exclude. A repo may omit those keys; cwd, env, select, python checks, exclude, protect and auto_merge_hold have no home default. Commands may name tools as {uv}, {go}, {gofmt}: replaced at load by the absolute path of the program home.json toolchains tools names (a missing tool fails the load), pinned per machine in the local.json next to it. Per language: extensions; coverage: command that writes the coverage file {report} (LCOV, or Go coverprofile with coverage_format gocover); in coverage only, {changed_dirs} repeats its argv item once per directory of the language's changed files, relative to cwd (--cov={changed_dirs}: no package list to keep up, and a changed file the report leaves out is a finding, never a pass); a fixed --cov=<package> list also works, but a changed file outside it is then not checked for coverage; test: fail-fast test command for mutants (auto-merge.py, local mode, also runs it as the full suite before merging); checks (optional, local mode): more completion checks auto-merge.py runs after test, same cwd, env and placeholders (format, lint): each an argv list (passes on exit 0), or {"argv": [...], "empty_output": true} that also fails on any output (e.g. ["gofmt", "-l", "."]); a failure refuses the merge, so the orchestrator doesn't run them by hand; cwd: where both run; env: extra variables ({repo}: this checkout, also from a scratch copy); invalid_exit_codes / invalid_patterns: results that mean the mutant didn't build. select (optional, Python with pytest-cov 7.1+; when its context run fails or records no per-test contexts, mutation falls back to the whole test command per mutant and says so in the scan result): {"kind": "pytest-contexts", "pytest": the pytest command without paths, "python": the project's Python (it reads the coverage data), "fallback": tests for a line no test context covers, {component} = the path's first directory}: mutation runs only the tests that executed each mutated line, and a later scan after test-only changes reruns only what they can affect. red_invalid_patterns: output that means the branch's first tests commit fails for the wrong reason (crap-gate wants it red only because the implementation is missing; a missing module or name is fine); red_invalid_exit_codes: exit codes that mean its tests never ran (pytest 4 usage error, 5 no tests collected). exclude: paths never checked (guard-paths tests and qaConfig are added). scratch_exclude: what the mutation copy leaves out ("dir/" from the root, a bare name anywhere). auto_merge_hold (local mode): paths that stop auto-merge.py for a person's review, on top of ~/.claude/config/home.json auto_merge_hold (e.g. data config). limits: overrides of ~/.claude/config/home.json quality (with the person's local.json next to it applied first). The hooks read this file (and guard-paths.json) as committed at the diff base, never the working tree: a change takes effect once merged. Commands run in bwrap (~/.claude/config/home.json gate_sandbox): no network, $HOME empty except the configured tool and cache paths, so use installed tools and offline flags (uv run --no-sync).
